name: ultrasearch-mcp
description: Production-grade web research tools for Claude Desktop.
long_description: UltraSearch MCP adds search, fetch, crawl, summarization, provider provenance, and budget-aware hosted fallback to Claude Desktop. Use local SearXNG, your own hosted provider keys, or both.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the web through SearXNG or hosted fallback providers.

tools.name: search_and_fetch
tools.description: Search and fetch relevant page content in one tool call.

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Fetch and extract content from a URL.

tools.name: search_and_summarize
tools.description: Search the web and synthesize a short summary.

tools.name: crawl_site
tools.description: Crawl a site within configured safety limits.

tools.name: clear_cache
tools.description: Clear cached search or fetch state.

searxng_url.title: SearXNG URL
searxng_url.description: Optional local SearXNG URL. Leave as default if you do not use SearXNG.

hosted_fallback_enabled.title: Enable hosted fallback
hosted_fallback_enabled.description: Use your configured hosted provider keys when local search is unavailable or weak.

tinyfish_api_key.title: TinyFish API key
tinyfish_api_key.description: Optional. Required only when TinyFish fallback is used.

exa_api_key.title: Exa API key
exa_api_key.description: Optional. Required only when Exa fallback is used.

parallel_api_key.title: Parallel API key
parallel_api_key.description: Optional. Required only when Parallel fallback is used.

brave_api_key.title: Brave API key
brave_api_key.description: Optional. Required only when Brave fallback is used.

tinyfish_location.title: TinyFish location
tinyfish_location.description: Optional two-letter location code such as US or CA.

firecrawl_url.title: Firecrawl URL
firecrawl_url.description: Optional Firecrawl API URL for crawl/fetch fallback.

firecrawl_api_key.title: Firecrawl API key
firecrawl_api_key.description: Optional. Required only when Firecrawl crawl/fetch fallback is used.
